sampling_rule: An independent reviewer authors prompts outside the public cases and optimizer context, records hashes before running, checks for known training/example overlap, and keeps prompt files outside this repository.
promotion_rule: Use identical runtime, decoding parameters and attempt/repair/time budgets for baseline and candidate. Promote only after held-out evaluation improves the predeclared primary metric without regressing hard source, execution or interaction gates. Report uncertainty for small samples.
invalidating_conditions: prompts or expected outputs leaked to optimizer
